question: Your support agent runs a triage step on each new customer message, and this step must end with a call to one of get_customer, lookup_order, process_refund or escalate_to_human. A later step writes the reply that the customer sees. Logs show that 12% of triage responses have stop_reason "end_turn" and contain only a text summary of the request. Which change best guarantees a tool call while letting the model choose the tool that fits?

options.text: Keep tool_choice at "auto" and rewrite the four tool descriptions so that the model strongly prefers a tool call over a text reply.
options.reason: With "auto" the model may still return text instead of calling a tool; better descriptions guide which tool is selected but do not guarantee that a tool is called, which is what "any" does.

options.text: Set tool_choice to "any" on the triage request, so the model must call one of the four tools but still picks the one that fits.
options.reason: The guide states that tool_choice "any" guarantees the model calls a tool instead of returning conversational text, and the model still chooses which tool to call.

options.text: Keep tool_choice at "auto" and resend the same request whenever stop_reason is "end_turn" until the response contains a tool call.
options.reason: Under "auto" a text-only response stays possible on every attempt, so resending adds cost and latency without a guarantee; the guide names tool_choice "any" as the setting that guarantees a tool call.

options.text: Set tool_choice to {"type": "tool", "name": "lookup_order"} on the triage request, so the model always calls a tool before it can write any text.
options.reason: Forced selection makes the model call one specific tool, which the guide uses to fix a required first step; here the right tool differs per request, so forcing lookup_order removes the model's choice.
